challengeQuestions.question: Under Section 6.1 (Financial Condition Covenant), what Consolidated Leverage Ratio level must the Borrower not exceed as of the last day of any four consecutive fiscal quarters (before any Qualified Acquisition step-up)?
challengeQuestions.expectedSourceBackedAnswer: 3.75 to 1.00 (with conditional Qualified Acquisition increase to 4.25 to 1.00 for a Leverage Increase Period under stated provisos)

challengeQuestions.question: What aggregate principal cap applies to Capital Lease Obligations and purchase-money Indebtedness under Section 6.2(e)?

challengeQuestions.question: What aggregate principal cap applies to additional Indebtedness under Section 6.2(i), including Attributable Debt in respect of Qualified Receivables Transactions?
challengeQuestions.expectedSourceBackedAnswer: $350,000,000 at any one time outstanding (Borrower and Subsidiaries aggregate, together with Attributable Debt in Qualified Receivables Transactions)
